children: On Holding AG Class A (NYSE:ONON) is doubling down on growth—projecting sales to at least CHF 3.55B by 2026 and entering football in 2027 with Kylian Mbappé and Thierry Henry attached—while investor day outlines a three‑year plan amid slowing retail, competition and mixed analyst targets.
On Holding AG Class A Deal With Mbappé
: On Holding AG Class A (ONON) struck a deal with Kylian Mbappé. Analysts say the soccer line could add $375–$400M in annual revenue by fiscal 2031, affecting brand spend.
: On Holding AG Class A (ONON) expects sales to double to at least CHF 3.55B by 2026, implying ~26% CAGR; current trajectory near 30% CAGR through 2026.
: ONON: Williams Trading cut target to $27 from $32; BofA cut to $43 from $46. About 25 of 31 analysts rate ONON buy/strong buy. 12‑month avg target $42.57 (~56% upside).
: On Holding (ONON) hosts investor day Tuesday; co-CEOs to present a three-year growth plan. Analysts flag slowing sales, tougher competition and advise lower wholesale expectations.
: On Holding AG Class A (ONON) named Thierry Henry Director of Football, formalizing his advisory role since late 2025 on football product and market entry strategy.
: On Holding AG Class A (ONON) enters soccer market as growth move; reports slowing sales growth, rising competition, weakest retail sales since 2021 IPO, and no plans to cut prices
: On Holding AG Class A (ONON) will enter football in 2027, launching football boots first, then kits, lifestyle items and trainers, applying its running-derived design approach across the rollout.
: ONON spotlights LightSpray robotic tech that sprays a continuous filament to form shoe uppers, marketed as a key manufacturing differentiator versus major rivals.
